introHtml: Russell Outdoors pullovers combine rugged durability with a classic fit, making them a go-to for outdoor workwear, team uniforms, and promotional giveaways. Unlike generic fleece, these pullovers feature reinforced stitching and fade-resistant fabrics that hold up to repeated washing and heavy use. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on the chest or back for a clean, professional look that stays sharp season after season.
